description: Defines classes and interfaces for buffer pool accessor and connection death notification in Android media bufferpool V2.0, including handling remote connection death, buffer allocation, fetching, and connection management.

classes.name: ConnectionDeathRecipient
classes.description: Handles death notifications from remote buffer pool connections, manages connection and cookie mappings.

classes.name: Accessor
classes.description: Implements buffer pool accessor interface, manages buffer allocation, fetching, connection, and cleanup.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers a new remote connection with its ID and accessor.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a remote connection by ID.

methods.name: addCookieToConnection
methods.description: Associates a cookie with a connection ID.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the buffer pool with an observer.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the accessor is valid.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Invalidates all buffers owned by the buffer pool.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a buffer from the buffer pool.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches a buffer for a specific transaction.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Creates a connection to the buffer pool with observer and descriptors.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Processes buffer status messages and cleans cache.

methods.name: getConnectionDeathRecipient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the death recipient object.

methods.name: createInvalidator
methods.description: Creates an invalidator for buffer management.

methods.name: createEvictor
methods.description: Creates an evictor for buffer management.
